title: Trace2ST: Recovering PLC Structured Text from I/O Traces with LLM Generation and Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.24979v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs), the industrial computers that operate power and process plants, often run programs whose source code is no longer available; however, every input and output of the controller is logged continuously. This paper therefore asks whether a large language model (LLM) can recover an executable program in Structured Text (ST), the standard PLC language of IEC 61131-3, from such input/output records (traces) alone and, equally important, how the recovered program can be verified. To answer this question, we build a generate-replay-feedback pipeline. First, the LLM writes a candidate program from a compressed summary of the trace, without ever seeing the original program. The candidate is then executed one control cycle (scan) at a time and compared with the recording, and whenever a mismatch occurs the corresponding part of the trace is returned to the LLM, for at most three revisions. translated_title: Trace2ST：利用大语言模型生成与验证，从输入/输出轨迹中恢复PLC结构化文本程序
translated_abstract: 可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）是驱动电力与流程工厂运行的工业计算机，其上运行的程序源代码往往已不复存在；然而，控制器的每一个输入和输出都会被持续记录。因此，本文探讨大语言模型（LLM）能否仅凭这类输入/输出记录（轨迹）恢复出以结构化文本（ST，即IEC 61131-3标准PLC语言）编写的可执行程序，以及同样重要的是，如何对恢复出的程序进行验证。为回答这一问题，我们构建了“生成—回放—反馈”流水线：首先，LLM根据轨迹的压缩摘要编写候选程序，全程不接触原始程序；随后，候选程序按单个控制周期（扫描）逐步执行并与记录进行比对，一旦出现不匹配，便将轨迹中对应的部分返回给LLM，最多进行三次修订。（原摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“生成—回放—反馈”流水线，使大语言模型仅凭PLC的输入/输出轨迹记录即可恢复出可执行的结构化文本（ST）程序，并通过逐扫描周期回放比对完成程序验证。
